_comment: Machine-readable contract for config descriptors (E68_S01_T01). lib/config/descriptors.js reads THIS file as its single source for which fields exist, which are required, which apply to which type, and which value shapes are legal; it carries no second copy of the field list. Human guide: project/documentation/config-descriptors.md. A descriptor lives at templates/config-descriptors/<file-id>.json, where <file-id> is the config basename without .json (override the directory with JENGA_CONFIG_DESCRIPTORS_DIR); files whose name starts with an underscore are ignored by the loader. -- FIELD SPEC VOCABULARY: 'kind' is the value shape (integer | string | boolean | array_of_keys | array_of_scalars | regex | enum | key_ref | scalar_of_type); 'required' is when the field must be present (always | editable | readonly | never); 'only_when' restricts the field to editable or read-only keys; 'applies_to' restricts it to the listed types; 'single_line' forbids newline characters; 'non_empty' forbids an empty or whitespace-only string; 'pattern' is a JavaScript regular expression the string must match; 'const' fixes the exact value; 'enum_from' names the top-level list that supplies the allowed values. -- Adding a field here without teaching the validator its 'kind' is rejected by the validator at load time, never silently ignored.
